label: TCGA-Glioma
description: External-validation set sourced from TCGA diffuse glioma .svs whole-slide images.
_note: stageA/stageB above are the TARGET to normalize TOWARD -- the class-balanced EBRAINS training reference (equal-weighted average across {GBM_IDHwt, astro_IDHmt_G2, astro_IDHmt_G3, astro_IDHmt_G4, control, oligo_IDHmt_1p19qdel_G2, oligo_IDHmt_1p19qdel_G3} for Stage-A, {IDH_mt, IDH_mt_1p19q, IDH_wt} for Stage-B; classes with fewer than 10 images excluded). CORRECTED 2026-07-30: this file previously (incorrectly) stored TCGA's OWN fitted average as the target, which would normalize images toward 'what TCGA on average looks like' (itself GBM/IDH-wildtype-majority under naive uniform sampling, ~44% of the Stage-A pool) instead of toward the training distribution.
fitted_from_stageA: Stage-A thumbnails: class-stratified fit, up to 100 images per class from EBRAINS data/ebrains_thumbnails/*/included/*.jpg.
fitted_from_stageB: Stage-B patches: class-stratified fit, up to 100 images per molecular class, pooled across all 5 folds of data/stage_b_cohort_RN18_F1/patches.

validated_against.note: TCGA's OWN class-balanced characterization (diagnostic only -- NOT used as the applied target). Computed the same way as the shared training reference: equal-weighted average across per-class fits, classes with n<10 excluded.
